name: Shreeji Translogistics Limited
about: Shreeji Translogistics Limited engages in the transportation of goods in India. The company offers full truck load transport, parcel and part load or less than truck load transport, custom bonded trucking, door-to-door delivery of parcels, over dimensional cargo, and railway rake handling and transportation services. It also provides shipping line container movement and 3PL and warehousing services. The company owns and operates a fleet of approximately 202 owned trucks and more than 4500 outsourced trucks. It serves e-commerce, fast-moving consumer goods, white goods, pharmaceutical, textiles, metals, and industrial sectors. Shreeji Translogistics Limited was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.
